observableBehaviors.description: An authenticated user can create a capsule from multiple existing garments with a name and occasion tag(s), and retrieve it afterward.
observableBehaviors.oracle: Create a capsule via the API referencing 2+ garment IDs, a name, and an occasion tag; fetch it by ID or from a list. Returned capsule must contain the same garments, name, and tags.

observableBehaviors.description: A search/filter endpoint returns capsules matching a query and excludes non-matching capsules.
observableBehaviors.oracle: Filter composition is observable only when the test data distinguishes a capsule matching every supplied filter from capsules matching only a strict subset. Evidence must exercise at least two filters together and include both a full match and partial matches. A capsule belongs in the composed result only when it satisfies every supplied filter; capsules satisfying only a subset must be excluded.

observableBehaviors.description: Marking a capsule as favorite persists and is reflected in subsequent reads.
observableBehaviors.oracle: Mark a capsule favorite, re-fetch it (or a favorites filter), flag must read true. Unmark, re-fetch, flag must read false.

observableBehaviors.description: A capsule created by one user is not returned in another user's capsule list or search results.
observableBehaviors.oracle: Create a capsule as user A. List and search as user B. The capsule must not appear in either.

riskHypotheses: Search/filter is implemented as a client-side or partial filter that still leaks non-matching or cross-user capsules.
Favorite toggle updates a separate table/flag inconsistently from the read path used by list/search.

testData.setup: Two distinct authenticated test-user accounts (A and B), each with at least 2 pre-existing garments available to assemble into capsules.
testData.cleanup: Delete any capsule records created during evaluation.

safetyLimits: Only interact with the two provisioned test-user accounts.
Do not attempt to enumerate or access any account other than A and B.
requiredEvidence: Full HTTP request/response transcript for every claim.
Any capsule ID referenced in a finding must resolve to an actual observed API response, quoted verbatim in the evidence artifact.
